name: Brightdeck
description:
Use A.I. Slides by Brightdeck to create PowerPoint presentations right inside Claude. Describe the deck you need and Brightdeck generates a beautifully designed presentation with tables, charts, and illustrations that exports to native PowerPoint (.pptx) and is fully compatible with PowerPoint, Google Slides, and Keynote.

Brightdeck can also add slides to a deck you already have or edit your existing decks. New slides match your existing fonts, colors, and layouts, so the rest of the presentation stays exactly as your team built it.

Available features include:
- Generate a full presentation from a topic, outline, or prompt
- Turn documents, reports, and rough notes into a slide deck
- Add new slides to an existing PowerPoint without breaking its design
- Speaker notes on every slide
- Refine slide content in a chat-based conversation
- Export and download as PowerPoint (.pptx) or PDF — fully editable shapes and text, not flat images

_published_faq.name: How do I add Brightdeck to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Brightdeck to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.brightdeck.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Brightdeck MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brightdeck lists 15 MCP tools, including deck_answer_questions, deck_approve_plan, deck_create_blank_presentation, deck_create_presentation, deck_create_presentation_v2, deck_export_pdf_url, deck_export_pptx_url, deck_get_presentation, deck_get_share_link, deck_get_task_status, deck_list_permissions, and deck_list_presentations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Brightdeck?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Brightdeck in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Brightdeck requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Brightdeck is developed by Brightdeck. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
